artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: The one script this cell adds. Reads the latest partition of the Scope account-return silver through InflectionSilverReader (one LIST, one GET) and the round-119 roster response as a local file (read only, hash-checked against the round-119 record). Hashes each id with the account_record_read key rule before anything is written. Holds no write call, no vendor call, no credential token and no s3 literal. Run once, read-only; the record hashes this file.

The DB-i-21 record: script hash, extract hash and the private extract path, the silver partition count, feed accounts, roster null-start count, feed NO_START_DATE_AT_SOURCE count, the two difference sets by sha256 with the feed class word of the first, S60 membership and class, the verdict, the S3 read count (2), zero writes, zero vendor calls, zero secret reads, and basis words. Counts, sha256 values and class words only. No push, no deploy.

Four rows appended as bytes, IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W321-S1 to S4 (OBSERVATION; S3 ARMED with the S60 row's owner as disarm owner): the 96-against-40 premise, the feed-universe extract scope, the S60 feed class, and the RETURNED class of the one difference account. Counts and class words only.
